name: agent-watcher
description: Always-on-top overlay showing live Claude Code state, driven by Claude Code hooks.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @agent-watcher/protocol && npm run build -w @agent-watcher/agent-adapters
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @agent-watcher/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @agent-watcher/desktop && npm run build -w agent-watcher-bridge
